title: Christening
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office community gathers for Cece's christening, leading to humorous interactions, conflicts over arrangements, and Michael's misguided attempts at celebration and heroism. The episode features scenes of church service, social mingling, and a chaotic bus trip to Mexico, highlighting character relationships and comedic moments.
